capability.purpose: Synthesize already-resolved conversation, Wayfinding, research, prototype, and repository evidence into a buildable specification without re-interviewing settled decisions.

use_when.text: An objective has been resolved to the point where a buildable specification can be written without re-asking settled questions
Wayfinding, grilling, research, or prototype work has produced decision records that must be consolidated into one specification
A specification must precede implementation slicing and downstream tracer tickets

do_not_use_when.text: The objective still contains unresolved decisions that require grilling or Wayfinding first
The work is small enough to be expressed as a single implementation slice without a separate specification
The required output is an architecture decision record, research report, or execution plan rather than a specification

inputs.name: resolved_context
inputs.description: Conversation, Wayfinding, research, and prototype artifacts whose decisions are already settled.

inputs.name: domain_language
inputs.description: Project domain terminology used to express requirements precisely.

inputs.name: repository_truth
inputs.description: Current repository state used to ground the specification in real interfaces and constraints.

outputs.name: specification
outputs.description: Buildable specification synthesizing settled decisions without re-interviewing them.

outputs.name: decision_pointer_map
outputs.description: Pointer map from each spec requirement back to the decision record that settled it.

outputs.name: out_of_scope_record
outputs.description: Explicit out-of-scope items with rationale to prevent scope expansion during implementation.

preconditions.description: Open decisions have been resolved through grilling, Wayfinding, research, or prototype evidence.
Project domain terminology is stable enough to express requirements precisely.

requirements.description: Settled decisions are recorded by pointer rather than re-interviewed in the specification.
Out-of-scope items are explicit and prevent downstream scope expansion.
Each requirement is concrete enough that a downstream capability can decompose it into tracer tickets.

evidence_outputs.name: specification
evidence_outputs.description: Buildable specification grounded in settled decisions and repository state.

evidence_outputs.name: decision_pointer_map
evidence_outputs.description: Pointer map from requirements to the decision records that settled them.

compatibility.notes: Public display name Spec is independent of canonical asset id software.spec-from-context.
